name: create-draft
description: Saves a plain-text email as a Gmail draft; nothing is sent (gmail__send-email sends at once). Optionally uses a threadId from gmail__search-messages to place the draft in that conversation.

to.description: One recipient address or several separated by commas.

cc.description: Optional CC addresses separated by commas.

bcc.description: Optional BCC addresses separated by commas.

threadId.description: Optional conversation thread ID from gmail__search-messages.
